name: com.voyageforge.bridge
description: Voyage Bridge is a Unity connectivity toolkit for managing environments, endpoints, and remote service access across local and server-side workflows.

samples.description: Demonstrates BridgeClient multi-endpoint usage with default endpoint, custom endpoint, and full URL scenarios.
Demonstrates how a package that depends on Bridge calls Web APIs through the static BridgeHub facade: a package-style static API wrapper plus the app-side client that registers itself automatically.
